svg.title: Week 9 · Individual practical · four stations
svg.desc: A: threat model and scanner triage, 35 minutes, 25 points. B: move old password records at login, 35 minutes, 25 points. C: fix injection and test it, 30 minutes, 25 points. D: check the login token and who owns the order, 30 minutes, 25 points. 145 minutes of tasks (130 on stations + 15 to check) plus 20 minutes for instructions and collecting papers (paper exam). Basic 50 + Technical 50 = 100 points, worth 6 + 6 course marks.
